mechanism_claims.claim_text: CIGB-552 penetrates MCF-7, HT-29, and H460 cells and uses both endocytosis and direct transduction, with contribution varying by cell line.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: CIGB-552 in MCF-7, HT-29, and H460 cells

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Phosphatidylserine surface level and COMMD1 expression/localization are presented as cell-line-dependent contextual factors for CIGB-552 sensitivity; COMMD1 endosomal co-localization is similar across the three cell lines while expression differs.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: CIGB-552 sensitivity context in MCF-7, HT-29, and H460 cells
mechanism_claims.limitations: This is contextual support for internalization/sensitivity, not a standalone antimicrobial mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Protein complementation supports an in-cell interaction between COMMD1 and the L2 peptide surrogate in MCF-7 and H460 cells; the paper uses L2 because CIGB-552 contains modified D-amino acids that cannot be translated inside cells.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: L2 surrogate and COMMD1 in MCF-7/H460 cells; bounded relevance to CIGB-552
mechanism_claims.limitations: The direct PCA construct uses L2, not full modified CIGB-552; final ontology preserves this as contextual rather than unqualified CIGB-552 direct binding evidence.
